razonamiento: The architecture depicts a multi-account/multi-environment CI/CD deployment pipeline using AWS Developer Tools. All 10 components from the whiteboard are confirmed in the narration (all with evidencia 'ambas'). The drawn bidirectional connections between Developer, CodeCommit, CodeBuild, ECR, CloudFormation, and VPC are preserved along with the pipeline orchestration flow mentioned in the narration. ECS, IAM, and ALB are present as whiteboard components and spoken deployment targets within the VPC.
nombre: Multi-VPC CI/CD Pipeline with AWS Developer Tools and CloudFormation
